SOS-CONTACTS now uses commonMain anchors for opening, root, contacts tab, message tab, list, search, contact row, contact toggle, message input and save.

Android and iOS resolve the native Compose/accessibility anchors directly. iOS taps the resolved toggle and message tab using element-relative coordinates because XCTest reports the semantic elements as existing but not always directly hittable.

Web/Wasm renders this surface through Compose canvas in the authenticated browser host, so testTags are not exposed as DOM or ARIA nodes. The Web runner uses a localhost-only product E2E bridge to invoke the same open callback, records missing DOM anchors explicitly, and captures the shared landscape split where Contacts and Message are visible together.
This is a focal reduction, not full SCR-SOS GO: real remote mutation persistence, five-contact limit/error states, permission-denied contacts picker states and rollback/error paths remain pending.
